text.p: These are the leading stories in the Ugandan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A top security officer in Uganda says the Sudan government should influence the Lord's Resistance Army to release 21 schoolgirls before Uganda reopens talks with Sudan on important issues.
- Fifty-seven U.S. soldiers to train Ugandan peacekeeping forces move to Kabamba Army Training College in central Uganda.
- Patients at Uganda's National Hospital provide their own food while student nurses make do with only one meal a day because of a severe food shortage.

- Makerere University dons complain to parliament and finance minister about tax imposed on extra money from their evening classes which compensates for their meagre salaries. ($1=1070 Ugandan Shillings)
